recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist composition featuring a man from behind walking down a road into a dreamscape where a tropical island, a rugged mountain, and a massive celestial planet coexist under a starry sky, all unified by a low-lying mist.
coreVisualRelationships: The man's tropical shirt pattern mirrors the island oasis on the right.
The road serves as a central perspective line leading the eye toward the horizon.
The massive planet in the background provides a curved frame for the upper half of the image.
The mist at the bottom anchors the subject while creating a sense of ethereal height.
coreInvariants: A lone male figure seen from the back carrying a guitar.
A dual-landscape featuring both arid mountains and lush tropical islands.
A dominant celestial body occupying the upper-left quadrant.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central male figure, medium-full shot, positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's back and the guitar case, providing a grounded focal point against the fantastical background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bottom center (subject) following the road upward, then sweeping left along the planet's curve to the top-left title area.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of atmospheric mist at the bottom and dark starry space at the top right to balance the complex central imagery.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated earth tones (sepia, beige, and grey) in the landscape and mist.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep indigo and charcoal for the night sky and space elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant oranges and teals found exclusively on the subject's shirt and the small globe icon.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright mist and dark sky; saturation is localized to the subject to draw immediate attention.
paletteRestrictions: Limit high saturation to the central figure

letterConstructionRules: Top title uses a formal, copperplate-style script with exaggerated flourishes.
Secondary text uses a clean, geometric sans-serif with extreme letter spacing.
Bottom title uses a bold, modern sans-serif with a graphic substitution for the letter 'O'.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the bottom title is replaced by a realistic 3D globe icon.
The 'U' in the bottom title features a vertical slit or stencil-like cut.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Classic script paired with modern, wide-spaced sans-serif for a luxury-meets-contemporary feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, high-contrast flourishes of the top title.
Provides the clean, geometric base for the bottom title.
Alternative for the wide-tracked secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal landscape with a man in a tropical shirt walking away on a road into a thick white mist. In the background, place a large moon-like planet on the left, a brown rocky mountain in the center-left, and a small tropical island with palm trees on the right. The sky should be a dark, starry nebula.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large white script title at the top center with a soft drop shadow. Add a secondary wide-tracked sans-serif line below it. Place a bold sans-serif title at the bottom center, replacing the 'O' with a small 3D earth globe.

verificationChecks: Is the man's shirt the primary source of color?
Does the script title have elegant, long flourishes?
Is the 'O' in the bottom title a globe?
Is the horizon line obscured by mist?

adjustableVariables: Density of the stars in the sky
Specific pattern on the subject's shirt
mustRedesign: Identifiable facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of disparate landscape elements

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic lighting on the man's shoulders from the sky.
Ensure the road perspective aligns with the central vanishing point.
Verify the globe icon is centered within the bottom text.
Confirm the script flourishes do not obscure the secondary text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surreal Landscape] + [Lone Traveler with Instrument] + [Celestial Background] + [High-Contrast Script/Sans-Serif Typography Pairing].
